{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]

# Check the `converted` status of QA orders
qa_converted = qa_orders['converted'].value_counts()

# Check if any QA orders have status 'refunded'
qa_refunded = qa_orders['status'].value_counts()

# Print results
qa_converted, qa_refunded"}
